definitions.eastAfricanCitizen: A citizen of the East African Community (per the Treaty for the Establishment of the East African Community Act, Cap. 4C).
definitions.africanCitizen: A national of other African countries outside East Africa.
definitions.resident: A person, other than a Kenyan or East African citizen, residing in Kenya with a valid resident permit.
definitions.nonResident: A national of any country other than an East African citizen or African citizen - THE RELEVANT CATEGORY for this project's Non-Resident-focused Soroi quoting per CLAUDE.md.
definitions.child: Per the Children Act - generally under 18; specific park tables split 'Adult' vs 'Child/Student'.
definitions.student: An individual not older than 23 from a recognized institution, visiting for educational purposes under a documented arrangement.
definitions.dailyFee: Valid for a single access, not exceeding 24 hours.
definitions.exemptions: Kenyan citizens aged 70+; persons with disability; children aged 5 and younger; registered tour drivers/guides/boat crew/porters (Tourism Regulatory Authority registered).

parkEntryFeesAdult.unit: per adult per day unless noted

vehicleEntry6to12Seats.note: Requisition form lists this figure ($1500) under a 'VEHICLE 6-12 SEATS' column identically across every park row - appears to be a flat vehicle fee regardless of park category, distinct from the per-day-per-vehicle 'Other Charges' table in the official fee sheet (600/1500/3000/4500/5000 KSH tiers below). [Unverified] whether these are the same fee expressed differently or two separate vehicle charges - flag before applying to a quote.

otherChargesFromOfficialFeeSheet.note: Not in the simpler requisition form - only in the 'official-fee-sheet' (KWS Conservation Fee October 2025) source. Extracted since park-fee-adjacent charges could matter for a full itinerary costing (e.g. vehicle/aircraft charges for a fly-in safari).
